017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter;
018
019
020import java.util.function.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
024
025import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
026import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
027
028/**
029 * Thin configuration façade over the always-on request-id correlation resolver.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * <b>The correlation lifecycle is now owned by the always-on resolver built into {@link RestSession} at session-build
033 * time</b> &mdash; it mints or honors the {@code X-Request-Id} correlation id for <i>every</i> request (including 404 /
034 * early-error paths that never reach a {@code @RestStartCall} hook), stashes it under
035 * {@code "requestId"}, echoes it on the response, and opens the {@code requestId} log-context scope.
036 * The real tuning knobs live on {@link RequestIdSettings} (resolved via {@link RestContext#getRequestIdSettings()}).
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * This filter is retained for source compatibility.  Its {@link #apply(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) apply}
040 * method is now <b>idempotent</b>: it reads the already-resolved id back through the {@link RestSession#fromRequest
041 * session-handle seam} and re-echoes it &mdash; it never double-mints.  Its per-instance builder knobs
042 * ({@link Builder#idSupplier idSupplier}, {@link Builder#validator validator}, {@link Builder#attributeKey attributeKey})
043 * are <b>documented no-ops</b>: configure {@link RequestIdSettings} instead.
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
046 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RequestIdSettings}
047 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestServerLoggingAndDebugging">Logging / Debugging</a>
048 * </ul>
049 *
050 * @since 10.0.0
051 */
052@SuppressWarnings({
053   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are HTTP header names (e.g. X-Request-Id); intentional
054})
055public class RequestIdFilter {
056
057   /** Standard request and response header name for the request id. */
058   public static final String HEADER_REQUEST_ID = RequestIdConstants.HEADER;
059
060   /**
061    * Legacy default validator pattern, retained for source compatibility.
062    *
063    * @deprecated The resolver now defaults to sanitize-and-accept (see {@link RequestIdSettings}); this pattern is no
064    *    longer applied.
065    */
066   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
067   @SuppressWarnings({
068      "java:S1133" // Retained indefinitely for source compatibility; not scheduled for removal, so not deleted
069   })
070   public static final String DEFAULT_VALIDATOR_PATTERN = "^[A-Za-z0-9-_]{1,128}$";
071
072   /**
073    * Constructor.
074    *
075    * @param b The builder configuring this filter.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
076    */
077   protected RequestIdFilter(Builder b) {
078      reqnn("builder", b);
079   }
080
081   /**
082    * Creates a new builder.
083    *
084    * @return A new builder.
085    */
086   public static Builder create() {
087      return new Builder();
088   }
089
090   /**
091    * Re-echoes the correlation id already resolved by the always-on {@link RestSession} resolver.
092    *
093    * <p>
094    * Idempotent façade: the id was already minted/honored/echoed at session build.  This reads it back through the
095    * {@link RestSession#fromRequest session-handle seam} (falling back to the {@code "requestId"}
096    * attribute) and re-echoes it on the response &mdash; it never double-mints.
097    *
098    * @param req The servlet request.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
099    * @param res The servlet response.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
100    * @return The resolved request id, or <jk>null</jk> if none has been resolved (e.g. invoked outside a Juneau call).
101    */
102   public String apply(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
103      reqnn("req", req);
104      reqnn("res", res);
105      var session = RestSession.fromRequest(req);
106      String id = session != null ? session.getRequestId() : null;
107      if (id == null && req.getAttribute("requestId") instanceof String s && ! s.isEmpty())
108         id = s;
109      if (id != null)
110         res.setHeader(HEADER_REQUEST_ID, id);
111      return id;
112   }
113
114   /**
115    * Builder for {@link RequestIdFilter}.
116    *
117    * <p>
118    * The tuning methods below are <b>documented no-ops</b> retained for source compatibility.  They still reject a
119    * <jk>null</jk> argument (so existing null-validation contracts hold) but no longer affect resolution &mdash;
120    * configure {@link RequestIdSettings} instead.
121    */
122   public static class Builder {
123
124      /**
125       * Constructor.
126       */
127      protected Builder() {}
128
129      /**
130       * <b>No-op</b> (retained for source compatibility).  Configure {@link RequestIdSettings.Builder#idSupplier} instead.
131       *
132       * @param value The supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
133       * @return This object.
134       */
135      public Builder idSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
136         reqnn("value", value);
137         return this;
138      }
139
140      /**
141       * <b>No-op</b> (retained for source compatibility).  Configure {@link RequestIdSettings.Builder#validator} instead.
142       *
143       * @param value The predicate.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
144       * @return This object.
145       */
146      public Builder validator(Predicate<String> value) {
147         reqnn("value", value);
148         return this;
149      }
150
151      /**
152       * <b>No-op</b> (retained for source compatibility).  Configure {@link RequestIdSettings.Builder#attributeKey} instead.
153       *
154       * @param value The attribute key.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
155       * @return This object.
156       */
157      public Builder attributeKey(String value) {
158         reqnn("value", value);
159         if (value.isBlank())
160            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument 'value' must not be blank.");
161         return this;
162      }
163
164      /**
165       * Builds the filter.
166       *
167       * @return A new {@link RequestIdFilter}.
168       */
169      public RequestIdFilter build() {
170         return new RequestIdFilter(this);
171      }
172   }
173}
